title: Fix 3 buggy Python math functions
description: Greenfield Python dirty scenario: a calc module has 3 broken implementations. Fix divide, is_prime, and factorial so all tests pass.

injections.content:
from src.calc import divide, is_prime, factorial


def test_divide():
    assert divide(10, 2) == 5.0
    assert divide(7, 2) == 3.5


def test_divide_by_one():
    assert divide(42, 1) == 42.0


def test_is_prime_true():
    assert is_prime(2)
    assert is_prime(3)
    assert is_prime(7)
    assert is_prime(13)


def test_is_prime_false():
    assert not is_prime(1)
    assert not is_prime(4)
    assert not is_prime(9)
    assert not is_prime(0)


def test_factorial():
    assert factorial(0) == 1
    assert factorial(1) == 1
    assert factorial(5) == 120
    assert factorial(6) == 720

task_spec.prompt:
Fix the 3 buggy functions in src/calc.py so all tests pass.

  def divide(a: float, b: float) -> float
    — return a / b

  def is_prime(n: int) -> bool
    — return True iff n is a prime number
    — 0 and 1 are not prime; 2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13 are prime
    — 4, 6, 9 are not prime

  def factorial(n: int) -> int
    — return n! for non-negative integer n
    — factorial(0) == 1, factorial(5) == 120

Do not modify the test file.
Run: uv run pytest tests/ -v
required_artifacts: is_prime returns True for primes, False for non-primes and n < 2
success_criteria: uv run ruff check src/ passes
followup_prompts: Run `uv run pytest tests/ -v` to check the current state. Walk me through what bugs you found and fixed. If any tests are still failing, show me the errors and fix them.
Final verification: run `uv run pytest tests/ -v` and confirm a completely clean build. Every test must pass — if any are still red, fix them now.
